question: When's the deadline?
expected: Applications are accepted any time, but the twice-yearly deadlines are March 15 and September 1 at 5:00 p.m. (no time zone given); the next one is March 15, 2027, and a deadline on a weekend or holiday moves to the next business day.
quote: Application deadline: March 15, 2027, 5:00 p.m. (annual deadlines March 15 and September 1; applications accepted any time)

question: Who is eligible to apply?
expected: 501(c)(3) public charities (509(a)(1) or 509(a)(2)) with tax-exempt documentation from the last five years, serving Colorado, with about 30% of project funds already committed; governmental entities are considered only in limited circumstances.
quote: Be classified by the Internal Revenue Service as tax-exempt under section 501(c)(3) of the Internal Revenue Code (the “Code”), classified as a public charity
